title: The Bleeding Altar
text: A stone altar weeps fresh blood. Carved into it: a die with a single eye. It wants to be fed.

options.label: Feed it (one hero loses 6 HP). Carve a die.
Walk away.

title: A Hanged Man's Purse
text: A body sways from an oak. A fat purse hangs from his belt. His fingers twitch.

options.label: Cut him down and take the purse.
Leave the dead in peace.

title: The Pilgrim's Fire
text: An old pilgrim with no eyes tends a small fire. "Sit," she says. "Or ask, and I will read your dice."

options.label: Rest by the fire (all heroes heal 6).
Ask for a reading (+3 Fate).

title: The Whispering Die
text: A black die lies in the mud, whispering your name. It is warm.

options.label: Roll it. (50%: carve a die and +2 Fate. 50%: a hero loses 8 HP.)
Bury it (+1 Fate).

title: The Ossuary Merchant
text: A smiling man in a coat of finger bones. "I buy what you won't miss. A little life, for a lot of gold."

options.label: Sell life (a hero loses 3 max HP) for 50 gold.
Refuse.

title: The Drowned Bell
text: A church bell rises from a black pond. Its rope is wet and cold.

options.label: Ring it (all heroes lose 3 HP, +5 Fate).
Do not wake what sleeps below.

title: Crow Feast
text: Crows tear at a fallen soldier. Something bigger moves behind them.

options.label: Chase them off (fight).
Search the body quickly (+12 gold, a hero loses 3 HP).

title: The Confessor
text: A priest without a face sits in a ruined booth. "Confess, and be made whole. The church accepts donations."

options.label: Confess and donate 20 gold (all heal 10, revive the fallen).
You have nothing to confess.

title: Cracked Shrine of Fate
text: Six stone faces, five of them broken. The last one still smiles.

options.label: Pray (all heroes lose 2 max HP). Carve a die.
Steal the offerings (+20 gold).

title: The Wounded Knight
text: A knight bleeds against a milestone. "Take my blade's secret," he gasps, "if you end my pain."

options.label: Grant him mercy. Carve a die.
Bandage him (-10 gold, +2 Fate).

title: The Weeping Statue
text: A stone saint cries real tears into a bowl. The water is warm and smells of iron.

options.label: Drink (all heroes heal 8, one hero loses 3 max HP).
Fill a flask for later (+2 Fate).

title: The Gravedigger's Bet
text: "Double or nothing," grins a man leaning on a spade. "Your gold against my grave goods."

options.label: Bet 15 gold (50%: +40 gold. 50%: lose it).
Ask what is in the graves (a carving, a hero loses 4 HP).

title: A Lost Child
text: A small girl stands in the road, holding a lantern. She asks you to walk her home. She has no shadow.

options.label: Walk her home.

lose.text: Her home is full of teeth.

options.label: Do not look into the lantern. Walk on.

title: The Burning Library
text: Books scream as they burn. One of them is bound in skin and is not burning at all.

options.label: Take the book (carve a die, a hero loses 5 HP).
Save what you can (+20 gold).
